# negative-coverage exhaustiveness ledger (debt D7 -- docs/verdict_policy.md
# Section 6). Each line is a positive case_id whose verdict guard has NO
# non-vacuity disposition yet (not SOUND_ROW / FAULT_INJECTION / REGISTRY /
# DEFERRED). Generated by tools/negative_coverage_audit.py --write-ledger.
# Disposing a case (add a sound NEG_ROW, register it, add a _neg case, or
# track it in deferred_negatives.json) MUST delete its line here too;
# --check fails on a new undisposed case or a stale (now-disposed) entry.
# When this file is empty every positive case is disposed -- the SSOT is
# proven complete.
